answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30329 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it lawful to marry a women when she is passing through her period. Question: Is it lawful to marry a women when she is passing through her period. Answer ID: 30329 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1075/665/L=1432) It is not prohibited to do nikah in menstruating period, but it is haram to have intercourse in this state. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
